sonnet.problem: This true/false card restates the answer to the card just before it (Satan asks to strike his 'flesh and bones') and adds only the 'curse You to Your face' claim. Cards 6 and 7 both cover verse 5, so one question would do.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card. ... Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The card recaps that Job lost his servants and his children, which is death, and then goes straight into a joke in the same card.
sonnet.rule: A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.

sonnet.problem: The last story card re-tells 'Seven days without a word' just after two choice cards covered verse 13. It adds nothing new, so it works as a recap instead of moving the passage along. It could be just the closing 'story isn't over' line.
sonnet.rule: No recap cards. ... When the passage's last verse is asked on a choice card, the last story card can be just this line.
